propositions: _paged_search loop has no offset-stall guard; a server that ignores startAt re-serves the same non-empty page forever, making the exit condition unreachable and causing unbounded looping (measured: 26 calls instead of 2).

Fail-open exception handlers at get_parent_map and all three fetch_snapshot enrichment sites (fetcher.py:610, 652, 688) swallow the pager's abort signal, converting it to silent degraded output rather than loud failure.
The pager must track the previous page's first issue key and raise BackendPaginationStallError on any repeat, because a startAt-honouring server always serves different issues at each offset.

The error must be re-raised ahead of broad exception handlers at exactly four sites: get_parent_map, and all three fetch_snapshot enrichment handlers, so truncation aborts loudly instead of writing a degraded snapshot.
The error belongs in core (_backend.py) so fetcher can name it without inverting layering (adapter cannot import core, but core is safe to be named in adapter-consuming code).
